profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Marqeta, Inc
profile.summary:
- Outcome driven software engineer with 15 years of experience in backend development with a focus on product design and development
- Currently working at Marqeta, Inc as a Staff Software engineer in Money movement products.
Worked at Cisco Systems as a Senior Software Engineer working on designing and developing microservices of Cisco DNAC for on-premises and cloud 
- Hands-on working experience to enhance, automate and improve multiple modules within a product for scalability and  resilient solutions in an agile environment 

Specialties: Product development, Object-oriented programming, Agile / Scrum, Requirement Gathering, Mobile Development, Extensive programming knowledge, ETL Process,  Effective team leader, Multi-Threaded programming, Debugging/Analysis

Technical Skills:
Languages:  Java/J2EE, Kotlin, Objective-C, SQL, PL/SQL, Javascript, Python
Frameworks:   Spring/Spring MVC, Spring Batch, Spring boot, Hibernate, PhoneGap/Cordova, Kubernetes, Docker, Maglev, RabbitMQ
Technologies	Web Services (SOAP, WSDL and REST), JMS, HTML, JSP, JavaScript, CSS, jQuery, AJAX
Databases:     MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Oracle Database 10g/11g
Tools 	Log4j, ANT, Visio, SVN, Eclipse, Xcode, JIRA, Bugzilla

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and developed various micro-services for both on-premise and cloud solutions (Cisco DNAC)
Tools & technologies: Java, Spring, Hibernate, MongoDB, Kubernetes, Docker, RabbitMQ etc.
• Designed and developed MongoDB layer which can be leveraged by all services without making any further changes
• Developed multiple features which are widely used across all services in DNAC
• Developed Unit Tests using Mockito and Functional tests using Selenium to ensure code / product quality
• Resolved many customer facing defects in timely manner without compromising code quality
• Received multiple recognitions for moving services from on-premise platform to cloud without making significant changes to the product

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Designed and Implemented Mobile POS (Point of Sale) application for American Eagle (AEO).
•	Designed and developed various modules within MPOS like Payments, Gift-Card support, Store Open/Close, Application Security, Cash Drawer Integration, Hardware integration like the scanner, Muira shuttle etc.
•	Implemented payment API and enabled support for EMV and Apple pay.
•	Designed Store-Hub solution as a service using Microservices, Kafka, Docker, spring boot etc.
•	Managing team of 5 offshore resources for design and development activities

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Developed Store Hub product to facilitate and accelerate the integration of multiple systems using Java, Spring, Spring Batch and JMS technologies. It transforms and transmits data between Oracle Retail Systems and existing legacy systems.
•	Implemented Store Hub solution for customers Vodafone Inc, Allied wireless, Holland & Barrett and Wana Telecom integrating their legacy systems/retail systems according to their requirements
•	Designed and developed the Monitoring tool to consolidate monitoring of retail infrastructure and applications operating on the Oracle Retail Stores Suite. It improved efficiency and reduced support time. 
•	Developed Web Interface to monitor Store hub (Spring Batch) jobs using Spring MVC.
•	Designed and developed new interfaces for different customers to expand project range. 
•	Developed Mobile Point of Sale (MPOS) application using Java/J2ME for Metra Rail-Chicago. 
•	Implemented ticket validation process using web service. Implemented client/server architecture on socket layer and developed user Interfaces using J2ME. Developed API which can print the receipt on wireless printers.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Designed and developed "Animated Power Plan" using ASP, HTML and Flash for new hires to explain the complex mechanism and process of electricity generation.
•	Upgraded company's website using ASP.Net, HTML and CSS.
•	Designed and developed auditing and reporting sharing website for employees to share the data across the company.
